title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MSR > R > PCM > CD, plus  MSR > ? > Beta PCM > D > CD, plus MSR > R > C > D > CD

ai_review.summary: Raw vintage Dead performance with standout Dark Star and a Bach minuet interlude, but the soundboard source is plagued by poor audio quality.
ai_review.review: Fans love the 1969 show for its eclectic mix of R&B, country, and psychedelic jams – highlights include Dark Star, Hard to Handle, Mama Tried and a surprising Bach minuet snippet.  However, the recording itself is widely criticized as low‑fidelity, with digital errors and a bad CD burn that make it hard to handle despite being a soundboard (SBD) source.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is praised by several reviewers (high energy, strong song selection), but recording quality is consistently described as poor, pulling the overall rating down.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Low fidelity, muffled and noisy; significant digital errors from a bad CD burn; hard to handle for listening despite being an SBD source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans appreciate the early‑Dead vibe and the eclectic mix of R&B, country and psychedelic jams; the set feels loose but exciting despite audio issues.
